stats: Marks are a family of Debuffs that apply powerful effects to a single enemy, usually for a limited duration. You can have multiple Marked enemies at once, but each individual enemy can only have a single Mark applied to them at once.
Marks can be Activated when specific conditions occur, which will case some extra effect and then Consume the Mark.
